notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hey there! Thanks to everyone for checking out THOHH in its first week on Steam and leaving some kind words ❤️ I noticed a few small things that weren't in order, so I've updated the game with the following:

- After choosing to leave with [spoiler]Rosalinde[/spoiler], you were able to talk to them again at the bottom of the stairs (and then they would disappear!) Fixed that.
- Fixed a bug where the pizza box would still be on the floor when reloading the last checkpoint after completing the game.
- Fixed the Sugar Rush achievement not unlocking.
- For the achievement hunters out there (and anyone who wants to revisit a specific scene), I added a chapter select option to the ingame pause menu (when you press ESC).

Lastly, I noticed that running the Mac version at a high resolution results in some input lag. I'm trying to think of a good way to fix that internally, but for the time being you can press ESC to open the pause menu, go into settings, then select 1920x1080 or less as the resolution, that should really help (it may take some cursor ballet to get there, but I hope that helps!)
